entry.title: RadixArk Ships DaisyRose-27B, a 27B Agentic Coding Model Trained With Reinforcement Learning Only
entry.summary: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, an Apache 2.0 agentic coding model post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B with reinforcement learning only. It more than doubles Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 to 12.0 and runs on a single GPU. The post RadixArk Ships DaisyRose-27B, a 27B Agentic Coding Model Trained With Reinforcement Learning Only appeared first on MarkTechPost.
